content.short: Alfred provides compliant cross-border payment infrastructure for Latin America.
content.description: Alfred connects stablecoins to local banking systems across Latin America, letting a business pay out in local currency from one integration. It holds connections to licensed payment networks in Mexico, Brazil, Colombia and Argentina among other markets. The product is a REST API with separate sandbox and production environments, and the company targets a two-week integration. Businesses use it to offer cross-border payments without negotiating banking relationships country by country.
content.meta: Alfred provides compliant cross-border payment infrastructure and virtual accounts for Latin America.
